Their cumulative exported-union span coverage is0.026696329254727477,0.3259620491526242,0.32739970594412937; final coverage is0,0.3259620491526242,0.3150073513967654. Final-selection-only repair cannot recover reference context absent from this confirmed union. Retrieval/delivery coverage is a supported investigation target, not proven architectural causality. No new model calls or accepted token savings; full campaign success remains false.

Two model and two tokenizer requests succeeded with zero retries/unknowns, consuming3001 known model tokens. The follow-up projected5007 tokens including reserves, delivered20 observations and returned all six required fields exactly. Retained-reasoning reservation was0, so the prospectively required positive-reasoning qualification failed. This supports limited encoded-payload interpretation, while fresh reasoning continuity remains untested.

The candidate failed its perfect-quality target: two of four tasks terminated on unbound finding references, and the completed pair are not perfect. All four costs total200173tokens and91calls with zero unknown usage. Completed task span-F1 is0.6436200758010795 and0.46512190207535764. Five read_file calls exceeded the100line limit.

Complete cost is207204tokens/97calls,zero unknown. All412confirmed observations are projected/exported with zero unmapped changed lines. Native mean span-F1 is0.26298605273582576 and file-F1 is0.5198412698412698; none is perfect. Confirmed exported-union span coverage is0,0.4860219207184588,0.30303507666456625,0.03746487667811427; every task lacks reference context before final selection.
